# temps_service_alert_rule (Resource)

An alert on a metric of a managed service (`temps_service`), such as its connection count or replication lag. The service needs metric collection turned on for the rule to be evaluated.

Import with `<service_id>/<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `external_services:read`, `external_services:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_service_alert_rule" "connections" {
  service_id        = temps_service.db.id
  name              = "Connections near the limit"
  metric_name       = "postgres.connections"
  threshold         = 180
  comparator        = ">="
  severity          = "critical"
  for_duration_secs = 120
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `comparator` (String) How the metric is compared with `threshold`. One of `>`, `<`, `>=`, `<=`.
- `metric_name` (String) Metric watched, as collected for the service's engine.
- `name` (String) Name shown in notifications.
- `service_id` (Number) ID of the managed service.
- `severity` (String) Severity of the alarm. One of `warning`, `critical`.
- `threshold` (Number) Threshold the metric is compared with.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Evaluate the rule.
- `for_duration_secs` (Number) Seconds the breach must last before the alarm fires; `0` fires at once.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<service_id>/<id>`.
- `silenced_until` (String) Time the rule is silenced until, if it is.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <service_id>/<id>
terraform import temps_service_alert_rule.connections 21/40
```
